title: Plumbing company websites and web apps | Creosote Labs
meta_description: Creosote Labs builds plumbing company websites with online booking, quote requests, and service area pages, plus customer portals and internal web tools.
h1: Website and web application development for plumbing companies
intro: A plumbing company's website usually has one job: turn a search for an emergency plumber or a water heater replacement into a phone call or a booked appointment. Many plumbing websites are built on WordPress or a template from the field service vendor, list services without prices, and route every request through a contact form that reaches the office hours later. Online booking through ServiceTitan or Jobber exists but is often not connected to the site in a way customers find.

Creosote Labs builds the marketing site and the tools behind it. That means service pages with clear descriptions and starting prices where the company wants to publish them, a booking flow connected to the dispatch platform, a quote request form that collects photos and the fixture in question, and service area pages for each town the trucks cover. Projects are quoted after a scoping call at a fixed price, and handover includes hosting, domain setup, and written documentation.
projects: A marketing site with a service page for each line of work, from drain cleaning to repiping, and a click-to-call header on mobile.
An online booking page that writes appointments straight into Housecall Pro with the customer's address and problem description.
A quote request form for water heater and fixture replacements that asks for a photo and the model number before the office calls back.
A customer portal where service agreement members see their visit history, upcoming maintenance, and invoices.
A web application for a commercial plumbing division that lets property managers submit work requests and check their status.

faqs.q: Does the site work with our dispatch software?
faqs.a: Yes, when the platform supports it. ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, and Jobber each offer online booking that can be placed on the site, and we can build a custom booking flow when the built-in one does not fit.

faqs.q: How much does a plumbing website cost?
faqs.a: Website and application projects are quoted after a scoping call. The price is fixed, with no hourly billing, and includes hosting setup, domain configuration, and documentation at handover.

faqs.q: What does the company need to provide?
faqs.a: The company provides a list of services and any prices to publish, the service area, photos of the team and trucks if available, and access to the domain and the field service platform for booking integration. We handle the rest.
